content.summary: Full Stack Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing scalable web applications, distributed systems, and modern cloud architectures using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js. Track record of improving system latency by 35% and leading cross-functional engineering pods.

bullets: Architected high-throughput data processing services using TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL handling 2M+ daily requests.
Spearheaded redesign of flagship customer portal with Next.js and React, driving a 28% increase in conversion and 400ms reduction in LCP.
Integrated automated testing and CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, reducing release cycle time by 45% across 5 teams.
Mentored 6 junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, architectural RFCs, and engineering brown bags.
Developed resilient REST and GraphQL APIs using Node.js, Express, and Redis caching layer.
Implemented real-time analytics dashboard with React, Tailwind, and WebSockets, cutting reporting delay from 10 minutes to under 2 seconds.
Collaborated with product designers to standardize internal component library, improving feature velocity by 30%.

education.details: Graduated with Honors. Coursework in Distributed Systems, Algorithms, and Cloud Infrastructure.

projects.name: Distributed Task Orchestrator
projects.description: Open-source distributed background job processor built in TypeScript with Redis pub/sub and zero external dependencies.

Required: 5+ years building distributed web applications with TypeScript, React, and Node.js. Experience with PostgreSQL, AWS, and modern CI/CD. Strong system design and leadership abilities.
